files.content:
# Monarch Production Slot Policy
CUSTOM-VALVE-12 may not sell below 601.60 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 627.20.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include production_slot_id, slot_date, capacity_commitment in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
production_slot_id: MONARCH-SLOT-206
slot_date: 2026-07-09
capacity_commitment: exclusive_half_day_run

files.content:
# Capacity Commitment Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: production_slot_id, slot_date, capacity_commitment.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include production_slot_id, slot_date, capacity_commitment with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.

# Production Slot Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-CM-OE-206
Item: CUSTOM-VALVE-12
Quantity: 12
Target unit price: 640.00
Required terms_json keys: production_slot_id, slot_date, capacity_commitment.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include production_slot_id, slot_date, capacity_commitment inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
Authorized values for this transaction:
production_slot_id: MONARCH-SLOT-206
slot_date: 2026-07-09
capacity_commitment: exclusive_half_day_run
